comparison.sham: Late critics, target critics and critic optimizer retained.
comparison.optimizer_reset: Late critics and target critics retained; fresh critic Adam.
comparison.critic_restore: Restore 500k critics and target critics; fresh critic Adam.
comparison.common_calibration: All three arms receive 500 critic-only updates with actor and entropy state frozen.
comparison.online_phase: Real new environment transitions are added to each arm's replay; normal SAC actor, critic and entropy updates resume.
comparison.streams: Matched initial replay, sampling seeds and per-worker episode-condition sequences within each base-seed/stream block; realized trajectories can diverge.

analysis.primary_endpoint: Final-budget fixed-validation tracking and qualification jointly.
analysis.additional: Raw and normalized RMSE, all seven reward components, commitment, queue saturation/debt, SOC, thermal warnings, online transitions and update counts.
analysis.unit: Four selected parent policies with three nested continuation streams; not twelve independent from-scratch seeds.
analysis.failure_policy: Retain every registered run and validation cell. Do not filter failed qualification or rerun failed jobs silently.
analysis.selection: Best qualified checkpoint is secondary; final-budget outcomes for all registered runs are primary.
analysis.held_out_peak_days: Never execute days 207, 248 or 249 in this pilot.
analysis.scope: Exploratory online recovery after degradation, not identification of its original cause or a general safety guarantee.

attempt_retention: All registered jobs and validation cells, including failures
scope: Nested continuation streams on selected parent checkpoints; no from-scratch or confirmatory population claim
